messages.content: Help me copy an NIO resource to a new path '/backup/data.txt' on the filesystem, ensuring that the copy operation overwrites any existing file at the destination, and track the progress using a progress monitor `progressTracker`?

function.name: EFSNIOResource_copy
function.description: Copies the NIO resource to the specified destination path on the filesystem, with an option to force overwrite and a monitor to track progress. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

destination.description: The destination path object where the resource should be copied to. Defined as a Path object that has constructor taking one path parameter This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

force.description: If true, the copy operation will overwrite existing files at the destination. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.

monitor.description: A progress monitor to track the copy operation progress. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function EFSNIOResource_copy with parameters: destination: string representing Path object; force: string "true"; monitor: string representing progressTracker.

We need to construct destination Path object: Path.of("/backup/data.txt")? In Java 8, Path.of is static method from java.nio.file.Path. But we can just pass string representation of Path object: "Path.of(\"/backup/data.txt\")". Or maybe "Path.of(\"/backup/data.txt\")" as string. Let's do that.

Also monitor: "progressTracker".

So call:

functions.EFSNIOResource_copy({
destination: "Path.of(\"/backup/data.txt\")",
force: "true",
monitor: "progressTracker"
})

Let's produce that.
